title: Friendly discourse
introduction: Sugreeva consoles Rama soothingly and advises him to come out of his frenzy emotion at the loss of Seetha, which is not befitting to a person like Rama. Rama recovering from his emotional state, promises Sugreeva to be truthful to his word in alleviating the fear of Vali for Sugreeva. And Sugreeva also promises to make all his efforts to search for Seetha.
closing: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये किष्किन्ध काण्डे सप्तमः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 7th chapter in Kishkindha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्तः तु सुग्रीवः रामेण आर्तेन वानरः |
अब्रवीत् प्राञ्जलिः वाक्यम् सबाष्पम् बाष्प गद्गदः
verses.iast:
evam uk{}taḥ tu sugrīvaḥ rāmeṇa ārtena vānaraḥ |
abravīt prāñjaliḥ vākyam sabāṣpam bāṣpa gadgadaḥ
verses.translation: Thus said by Rama in agony that monkey Sugreeva with his palms adjoined, and with tears rolling in eyes and also voice trembling with tears said this to Rama.

verses.devanagari:
न जाने निलयम् तस्य सर्वथा पाप रक्षसः |
सामर्थ्यम् विक्रमम् वा अपि दौष्कुलेयस्य वा कुलम्
verses.iast:
na jāne nilayam tasya sarvathā pāpa rakṣasaḥ |
sāmarthyam vikramam vā api dauṣkuleyasya vā kulam
verses.translation: "Unfamiliar is the residence, or capability, or valour, or lineage of that sinning demon from a sinister dynasty, in any wise...

glosses.meaning: of his, of that sinning, demon's

verses.devanagari:
सत्यम् तु प्रतिजानामि त्यज शोकम् अरिन्दम |
करिष्यामि तथा यत्नम् यथा प्राप्स्यसि मैथिलीम्
verses.iast:
satyam tu pratijānāmi tyaja śokam arindama |
kariṣyāmi tathā yatnam yathā prāpsyasi maithilīm
verses.translation: "Truthfully I am promising you, oh, enemy destroyer, as to how you will get back Maithili therefor I strive to make effort, let anguish be discarded...

glosses.meaning: to you, truthfully, I am promising
Maithili, as to how, you get back
therefor, make effort, I strive to

verses.devanagari:
रावणम् सगणम् हत्वा परितोष्य आत्म पौरुषम् |
तथा अस्मि कर्ता नचिराद् यथा प्रीतो भविष्यसि
verses.iast:
rāvaṇam sagaṇam hatvā paritoṣya ātma pauruṣam |
tathā asmi kartā nacirād yathā prīto bhaviṣyasi
verses.translation: "As to how you will satisfy yourself on killing Ravana along with his henchmen, and as to how to you pride yourself thereby, I will make it happen in that way in no longer a time...

glosses.meaning: as to how, you will be gladdened
that way, not, before long, done, by me.

verses.devanagari:
अलम् वैक्लव्यम् आलम्ब्य धैर्यम् आत्मगतम् स्मर |
त्वत् विधानाम् न सदृशम् ईदृशम् बुद्धि लाघवम्
verses.iast:
alam vaiklavyam ālam.hbya dhairyam ātmagatam smara |
tvat vidhānām na sadṛśam īdṛśam buddhi lāghavam
verses.translation: "Enough is this clinging on to despair, recollect your inherent courage, and it is unseemly for persons of your sort to have this kind of mental ineptness...

glosses.meaning: soul gone in [inherent,] courage, you recollect

verses.devanagari:
मया अपि व्यसनम् प्राप्तम् भार्या विरहजम् महत् |
न अहम् एवम् हि शोचामि धैर्यम् न च परित्यजे
verses.iast:
mayā api vyasanam prāptam bhāryā virahajam mahat |
na aham evam hi śocāmi dhairyam na ca parityaje
verses.translation: "Upon me too this yearning caused by the separation of wife has chanced, but I did not despair this way, nor I have forsaken my courage...

verses.devanagari:
न अहम् ताम् अनुशोचामि प्राकृतो वानरो अपि सन् |
महात्मा च विनीतः च किम् पुनर् धृतिमान् महान्
verses.iast:
na aham tām anuśocāmi prākṛto vānaro api san |
mahātmā ca vinītaḥ ca kim punar dhṛtimān mahān
verses.translation: "Though I am a primitive monkey I am not totally disheartened for the distancing of wife, why tell about a great soul like you who are well read and courageous...

glosses.meaning: I am, being primitive, monkey, even though
of her [for distancing wife,] not, [totally] disheartening
you are, what again [why tell about you.]

verses.devanagari:
बाष्पम् आपतितम् धैर्यात् निग्रहीतुम् त्वम् अर्हसि |
मर्यादाम् सत्त्व युक्तानाम् धृतिम् न उत्स्रष्टुम् अर्हसि
verses.iast:
bāṣpam āpatitam dhairyāt nigrahītum tvam arhasi |
maryādām sattva yuk{}tānām dhṛtim na utsraṣṭum arhasi
verses.translation: "It is apt of you to control trickling tears with courage, and equally it is inapt of you to discard the courage and propriety of self-controlled people...

glosses.itrans: tvam aa patitam baashpam dhairyaat nigrahiitum arhasi
glosses.iast: tvam ā patitam bāśpam dhairyāt nigrahītum arhasi
glosses.devanagari: त्वं आ पतितं बाश्पं धैर्यात् निग्रहीतुं अर्हसि
glosses.meaning: you, trickling, tears, with courage, to control, apt of you
that which belonging to self-controlled ones
not, to discard, apt of you.

verses.devanagari:
व्यसने वा अर्थ कृच्छ्रे वा भये वा जीवितान्तगे |
विमृशन् वै स्वया बुद्ध्या धृतिमान् न अवसीदति
verses.iast:
vyasane vā artha kṛcchre vā bhaye vā jīvitāntage |
vimṛśan vai svayā buddhyā dhṛtimān na avasīdati
verses.translation: "Either in a riddle, or in financial loss, or at the end of life, or in fear, a courageous one does not sink down, but indeed introspects in his own mind...

verses.devanagari:
बालिशस् तु नरो नित्यम् वैक्लब्यम् योऽनुवर्तते |
स मज्जति अवशः शोके भार आक्रान्ता इव नौः जले
verses.iast:
bāliśas tu naro nityam vaiklabyam yo'nuvartate |
sa majjati avaśaḥ śoke bhāra ākrāntā iva nauḥ jale
verses.translation: "Stupid is that man who always follows self-piteous sadness unable to control himself, and he drowns down in that melancholy like a overweighing ship in waters...

glosses.meaning: like stupid, always, self-pity, he who follows

verses.devanagari:
एषो अन्जलिः मया बद्धः प्रणयात् त्वाम् प्रसादये |
पौरुषम् श्रय शोकस्य न अन्तरम् दातुम् अर्हसि
verses.iast:
eṣo anjaliḥ mayā baddhaḥ praṇayāt tvām prasādaye |
pauruṣam śraya śokasya na antaram dātum arhasi
verses.translation: "Adjoined are my palms in this way beseeching you in friendship, kindly bear up your self-esteem and you should not give any leeway to sadness...

glosses.meaning: for sadness, leeway, to give, not, apt of you.

verses.devanagari:
ये शोकम् अनुवर्तन्ते न तेषाम् विद्यते सुखम् |
तेजः च क्षीयते तेषाम् न त्वम् शोचितुम् अर्हसि
verses.iast:
ye śokam anuvartante na teṣām vidyate sukham |
tejaḥ ca kṣīyate teṣām na tvam śocitum arhasi
verses.translation: "Those that delve deep into moroseness, to them there is no happiness, and their brilliance too dwindles, thus saddening is inapt on your part...

verses.devanagari:
शोकेन अभिप्रपन्नस्य जीविते च अपि संशयः |
स शोकम् त्यज राजेन्द्र धैर्यम् आश्रय केवलम्
verses.iast:
śokena abhiprapannasya jīvite ca api saṃśayaḥ |
sa śokam tyaja rājendra dhairyam āśraya kevalam
verses.translation: "One well-engulfed in sadness doubts even his life, oh, king of kings, leave off that sadness and just hold on to courage...

verses.devanagari:
हितम् वयस्य भावेन ब्रूमि न उपदिशामि ते |
वयस्यताम् पूजयन् मे न त्वम् शोचितुम् अर्हसि
verses.iast:
hitam vayasya bhāvena brūmi na upadiśāmi te |
vayasyatām pūjayan me na tvam śocitum arhasi
verses.translation: "I am telling a benefiting and friendly thought, but not instructing you, should you regard my friendship then your saddening is inapt..." [Thus said Sugreeva to Rama.]

verses.devanagari:
मधुरम् सान्त्वितः तेन सुग्रीवेण स राघवः |
मुखम् अश्रु परि क्लिन्नम् वस्त्र अन्तेन प्रमार्जयत्
verses.iast:
madhuram sān.htvitaḥ tena sugrīveṇa sa rāghavaḥ |
mukham aśru pari klinnam vastra antena pramārjayat
verses.translation: Sweetly solaced thus by that Sugreeva Rama dabbed his face with the edge of cloth, which is covered fully with tears.

verses.devanagari:
प्रकृतिः स्थः तु काकुत्स्थः सुग्रीव वचनात् प्रभुः |
संपरिष्वज्य सुग्रीवम् इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
prakṛtiḥ sthaḥ tu kākutsthaḥ sugrīva vacanāt prabhuḥ |
sampariṣvajya sugrīvam idam vacanam abravīt
verses.translation: Lord Rama steadied himself in his own nature by the words of Sugreeva, and on embracing him Rama said this sentence to him.

glosses.meaning: in his own nature, steadied himself

verses.devanagari:
कर्तव्यम् यत् वयस्येन स्निग्धेन च हितेन च |
अनुरूपम् च युक्तम् च कृतम् सुग्रीव तत् त्वया
verses.iast:
kartavyam yat vayasyena snigdhena ca hitena ca |
anurūpam ca yuk.htam ca kṛtam sugrīva tat tvayā
verses.translation: "Sugreeva, a friendly obligation that which is to be done, a benefiting, befitting and a timely one too, is what you have performed with your friendly advise...

glosses.meaning: by a friend, friendly one, also
by friend, that which, is to be done

verses.devanagari:
एष च प्रकृतिः स्थः अहम् अनुनीतः त्वया सखे |
दुर्लभो हि ईदृशो बन्धुः अस्मिन् काले विशेषतः
verses.iast:
eṣa ca prakṛtiḥ sthaḥ aham anunītaḥ tvayā sakhe |
durlabho hi īdṛśo bandhuḥ asmin kāle viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, friend, I steadied myself in my own nature when implored by you... it is impossible to get this kind of friend, especially at these times...

glosses.meaning: in my nature, I steadied myself
this kind of, friend, impossible to get, indeed

verses.devanagari:
किम् तु यत्नः त्वया कार्यो मैथिल्याः परिमार्गणे |
राक्षसस्य च रौद्रस्य रावणस्य दुरात्मनः
verses.iast:
kim tu yatnaḥ tvayā kāryo maithilyāḥ parimārgaṇe |
rākṣasasya ca raudrasya rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ
verses.translation: "But, trying to search for Maithili and that furious, evil-minded demon Ravana, is your endeavour...

glosses.meaning: evil-minded one, of demon's, furious, Ravana's
search for, endeavour, is to be done.

verses.devanagari:
मया च यद् अनुष्ठेयम् विस्रब्धेन तत् उच्यताम् |
वर्षासु इव च सुक्षेत्रे सर्वम् संपद्यते तव
verses.iast:
mayā ca yad anuṣṭheyam visrab.hdhena tat ucyatām |
varṣāsu iva ca sukṣetre sarvam sampadyate tava
verses.translation: "What is to done by me that be said in all believability, and all your endeavour will reap like the crops planted during rainy season in good lands...

glosses.meaning: by me, also, what, that is to be done
in rainy season, in good lands, as though [seeded crop]

verses.devanagari:
मया च यदिदम् वाक्यम् अभिमानात् समीरितम् |
तत् त्वया हरिशार्दूल तत् त्वम् इति उपधार्यताम्
verses.iast:
mayā ca yadidam vākyam abhimānāt samīritam |
tat tvayā hariśārdūla tat tvam iti upadhāryatām
verses.translation: "What that is spoken by me is in my self-confidence but not in any self-conceit, oh, tigerly-monkey, deem them as doubtless facts...

verses.devanagari:
अनृतम् न उक्त पूर्वम् मे न च वक्ष्ये कदाचन |
एतत् ते प्रतिजानामि सत्येन एव शपामि अहम्
verses.iast:
anṛtam na uk{}ta pūrvam me na ca vakṣye kadācana |
etat te pratijānāmi satyena eva śapāmi aham
verses.translation: "Untruth is not uttered by me earlier nor will be at anytime from now, and all this I am promising you taking oath on that truthfulness alone..

glosses.meaning: anytimec[from now,] not, also, will speak
I am, by truthfulness, alone taking oath.

verses.devanagari:
ततः प्रहृष्टः सुग्रीवः वानरैः सचिवैः सह |
राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा प्रतिज्ञातम् विशेषतः
verses.iast:
tataḥ prahṛṣṭaḥ sugrīvaḥ vānaraiḥ sacivaiḥ saha |
rāghavasya vacaḥ śrutvā pratijñātam viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Then on hearing the words of Rama Sugreeva along with his monkey ministers is gladdened, especially of Rama promise.

glosses.meaning: vaanaraiH saha = with ministers, monkeys, along with

verses.devanagari:
एवम् एकान्त संपृक्तौ ततः तौ नर वानरौ |
उभौ अन्योन्य सदृशम् सुख दुःखम् अभाष्ताम्
verses.iast:
evam ekānta sampṛk{}tau tataḥ tau nara vānarau |
ubhau anyonya sadṛśam sukha duḥkham abhāṣtām
verses.translation: Then those two, the man and the monkey, met in privacy and both discussed in a mutually befitting manner about their pleasures and pains.

verses.devanagari:
महानुभावस्य वचो निशम्य
हरिर् नृपाणाम् अधिपस्य तस्य |
कृतम् स मेने हरिवीर मुख्यः
तदा च कार्यम् हृदयेन विद्वान्
verses.iast:
mahānubhāvasya vaco niśamya
harir nṛpāṇām adhipasya tasya |
kṛtam sa mene harivīra mukhyaḥ
tadā ca kāryam hṛdayena vidvān
verses.translation: On hearing the word of that intellectual, highly capable one and the best king among kings, namely Rama, he that Sugreeva, the chief among the monkey heroes, thought at heart that his manoeuvre to surpass his dominant brother Vali is accomplished.

glosses.meaning: he that one, among monkey, heroes, chief
